title: MONTHLY ENTERPRISE CYBERSECURITY
THREAT INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY
report.prepared: Automated summary, refreshed daily at 7:00 AM ET
report.sourceNote: Compiled automatically from CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD, VulnCheck, Metasploit, Exploit-DB, PoC-in-GitHub and MITRE ATT&CK. Counts are catalog counts, not a count of cyber incidents; anything the sources do not establish is stated as not established.

blocks.text: CISA added **42 vulnerabilities** to the KEV catalog in November 2026 (month to date through November 27, 2026), spanning 31 vendors. CISA flags known ransomware use for 1 of them. The highest-likelihood additions by EPSS were **CVE-2026-123158 (OpenBSD OpenSSH)** and **CVE-2026-116779 (SignalWire FreeSwitch)**. Outside KEV, 4 further CVEs were reported exploited or tracked as zero-days by Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD or VulnCheck.
These are CISA KEV catalog counts, not a count of total cyber incidents.

**Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed OpenBSD OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158); (2) isolate or patch exposed SignalWire FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779); (3) isolate or patch exposed Vates Xen Orchestra (CVE-2026-133469); (4) isolate or patch exposed Project MONAI MONAI Label (CVE-2026-133968); (5) examine OpenBSD OpenSSH hosts for unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-123158 - OpenBSD OpenSSH authentication bypass (CVSS 8.1).** sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): openssh 10.6. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-116779 - SignalWire FreeSwitch command injection (CVSS 9.8).** FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.3, sofia_presence_handle_sip_i_message() split the To user of an inbound SIP MESSAGE on a plus sign and treated the left side as a chat protocol selector. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): freeswitch 1.11.3. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-133469 - Vates Xen Orchestra authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8).** XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): xen orchestra server 5.211.2, xen orchestra server 5.213.1, xen orchestra 6.9.2, xen orchestra 6.10.1. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Nov 2: 3; week of Nov 9: 12; week of Nov 16: 9; week of Nov 23: 18.
Known ransomware use (CISA): CVE-2024-10441 (Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)).
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.

**Defensive hunting focus:** unexpected child processes and outbound connections (14 CVEs); unusual requests and changes (13 CVEs); unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes (11 CVEs).
